model: Brompton X Shantell Martin P Line - 4-speed
description: Is city exploration top of your bucket list? Then you need the P Line from Brompton. Offering the ultimate city riding experience for avid adventurers who want to glide around culture-filled streets effortlessly, this model balances refinement with power perfectly. Letting you roll and race to your heart's content, this high-performance bike offers elevated engineering with splendid design features. This machine is for you if you are ready to explore new horizons with an open mind and an ergonomic bike to match. The lightweight frame is 700 grams lighter than all-steel equivalents allowing easy transportation and agile riding. City exploration should be fun and smooth, which the P Line model guarantees. Features that facilitate this include the responsive suspension block, shock-absorbing titanium frame, and the 4-speed gearing system to ensure a comfortable ride at any speed. In addition to the comfortable ride, the intelligently engineered gears have been crafted with city adventures being considered meaning you can safely weave around tight corners and alongside traffic with complete control. This model also folds away into a compact and lightweight design to make it possible for you to experience every inch of urban life. Additional features, such as the easy-to-handle frame and front carrier block, further enhance usability. Finished with the signature Brompton stunning design, this elegant yet powerful model showcases that strength can be found in even the most refined of moments. Allowing you to enjoy a speedy ride and handy for built-up areas, the P Line epitomizes mindful moments.

components.description: 6061 forged aluminum crank with 54T chainring and integrated chainguard
Titanium fork with a threaded headset
Superlight lock-on grips with precision ground foam adhered to ultra thin engineered core
Front carrier block adaptor for all types of Brompton luggage
Machined aluminum seat clamp and rear frame clip in anodised matt black finish
Machined aluminum hinge clamp levers and plates anodised matt black finish
Double wall rim, double-butted spokes and aluminum hub body
Superlight front wheel - Lightweight, double wall rim, double-butted spokes and aluminum hub body
